items.title: Touch-First Play
items.description: Design mobile-first interactions around touch, pointer, forgiving hit areas, gesture arbitration, and immediate feedback.
items.description_sl: Oblikuj mobilne interakcije okoli dotika, kazalca, prizanesljivih območij zadetka, razločevanja gest in takojšnjega odziva.

items.title: Motion Art Direction
items.description: Define a coherent motion language, hierarchy, timing palette, and reduced-motion interpretation before implementation.
items.description_sl: Pred implementacijo določi skladen jezik gibanja, hierarhijo, časovni značaj in različico z zmanjšanim gibanjem.

items.title: Expressive Critter Motion
items.description: Create readable personality using procedural motion, gaze, pose changes, anticipation, recovery, and simple animation primitives.
items.description_sl: Ustvari berljivo osebnost s proceduralnim gibanjem, pogledom, spremembami poze, anticipacijo, umiritvijo in preprostimi animacijskimi gradniki.

items.title: SVG Authoring
items.description: Author semantic, reusable, motion-ready inline SVG for interactive scenes, props, terrain, icons, and lightweight characters.
items.description_sl: Ustvarjaj semantične, ponovno uporabne in za gibanje pripravljene inline SVG-je za interaktivne prizore, rekvizite, teren, ikone in lahke like.

items.title: SVG Motion
items.description: Animate inline SVG with ambient, entity, reactive, and effect layers using CSS, WAAPI, and focused JavaScript.
items.description_sl: Animiraj inline SVG z ambientalnimi, entitetnimi, odzivnimi in efekt vrstami gibanja prek CSS, WAAPI in usmerjenega JavaScripta.

items.title: Living World Behavior
items.description: Build lightweight autonomous behavior, local reactions, social rules, memory, and bounded randomness for tiny living worlds.
items.description_sl: Zgradi lahkotno avtonomno vedenje, lokalne odzive, družbena pravila, spomin in omejeno naključnost za majhne žive svetove.

items.title: Canvas World Engine
items.description: Implement a lightweight mobile-first Canvas 2D world with resilient pointer input, clean loops, DPR handling, and performance budgets.
items.description_sl: Implementiraj lahek mobilni Canvas 2D svet z zanesljivim vnosom kazalca, čistimi zankami, upravljanjem DPR in zmogljivostnimi omejitvami.

items.title: Research Max
items.description: Evidence-first research orchestration with depth levels, modifiers, source verification, and practical synthesis.
items.description_sl: Raziskovalni postopek z dokazi na prvem mestu, stopnjami globine, modifikatorji, preverjanjem virov in praktično sintezo.

items.title: SVG World
items.description: Build a mobile-first single-file interactive world authored from inline SVG with constrained skill routing and an implementation audit.
items.description_sl: Zgradi mobilni interaktivni svet v eni datoteki iz inline SVG-ja, z omejenim usmerjanjem veščin in revizijo implementacije.

items.title: Critter Prototype
items.description: Create a tiny mobile-first world whose critters behave autonomously, react to touch, and recover naturally after interaction.
items.description_sl: Ustvari majhen mobilni svet, kjer se bitja vedejo avtonomno, odzivajo na dotik in se po interakciji naravno vrnejo v svoje vedenje.

items.title: Scene Decomposition
items.description: Analyze a flattened scene and plan a compact set of clean, reusable layers for interactive 2D/2.5D or WebGPU reconstruction.
items.description_sl: Analiziraj sploščen prizor in načrtuj kompakten nabor čistih, ponovno uporabnih plasti za interaktivno 2D/2.5D ali WebGPU rekonstrukcijo.
